title: Transitions
description: A queue's topology as data: the discipline that orders it, and one row per event a tick judges of a merge request, naming the state the merge request goes to and the actions the adaptor performs. The tick's module says which events and states a queue knows.

queue.description: The queue the table belongs to.

discipline.description: The queue discipline that orders the entries, a plugin of the queue kind.

transitions.description: One row per event, in any order.

event.description: The event the row answers, one the tick's module judges.

to.description: The state the merge request goes to, the label the tick renders.

actions.description: The actions the adaptor performs, in order, by name.
